Chapter 636: Chapter 47 ‘Aiding the Enemy’? (5200 words, please subscribe)_2

No Ninth Rank Alien Race would dare to resist or hesitate.

If their resistance caused the Galaxy Master to come, wouldn’t that be seeking death?

Indeed, in the hearts of all Ninth Rank Alien Races, even if the Galaxy Master were strong, he couldn’t possibly kill their tens of thousands of Ninth Ranks.

But if the Galaxy Master was determined to kill, he might not finish tens of thousands, but a few hundred were still within the realm of hope to be killed.

No Ninth Rank Alien Race wanted to be one of those few hundred.

Therefore, when facing the encirclement of human Evolvers, even if the other side was not as strong as they were, those Ninth Rank Alien Races would choose to flee rather than try to counter-kill.

...

…

Outside the canyon.

Duoke and several other special Ninth Ranks from Human Civilization were also observing the distant canyon.

“We can only suppress them to this point, any more suppression, and it would force these Different Species to resist,” a special Ninth Rank of Human Civilization said.

These Ninth Rank Alien Races have been chased to this point and dare not fight back.

Apart from the fear of the Galaxy Master, what was more important was that they still had a way out.

But now?

All Different Species had been suppressed within the canyon, with many Spatial Layers also sealed off.

These Ninth Rank Alien Races now had no way out, and further suppression at this point would only arouse their willingness to resist.

“Galaxy Master.”

“Where is the Galaxy Master?”

A few special Ninth Ranks from humanity spoke with some concern.

They had already cornered all the Ninth Rank Alien Races here; if the Galaxy Master still did not show up, it would be the turn of humanity’s Evolvers to flee for their lives.

“The Galaxy Master said he would come, so he will definitely come,” Duoke said with a firm tone.

The rest of the special Ninth Ranks felt slightly reassured.

Just then.

Above the canyon.

Suddenly, a figure appeared.

The figure was a young man, wearing a long robe, standing as if connected to countless Spatial Layers.

“Galaxy Master.”

“The Galaxy Master has arrived.”

On the side of Human Civilization, spirits were uplifted upon seeing Lin Yuan appear.

On the other hand, inside the canyon, the numerous Ninth Rank Alien Races had grave expressions, with even fear emerging.

“Galaxy Master?”

“It is said that the Galactic Star Master has opened at least a hundred million Spatial Layers?”

“A hundred million Spatial Layers? I wonder if the Tree Realm’s child, the Dragon Scale King, could match up to the Galaxy Master.”

Each of the Ninth Rank Alien Races had a somber face, feeling immense pressure.

Even though they also had their trump cards and backup plans, when truly facing the Galaxy Master, they still couldn’t maintain their composure.

The Tree Realm’s child, the Dragon Scale King, though powerful, had never killed a special Ninth Rank, but the Galaxy Master had, and he had killed Hunyi, a Ninth Rank who had opened more than thirty million Spatial Layers.

Who wouldn’t fear that?

“Everyone’s here?”

Lin Yuan looked down and asked, “Are there other presences hiding somewhere?”

Lin Yuan glanced at several inconspicuous locations, where he sensed several subtle presences, much stronger than Hunyi.

This wasn’t reliant on Lin Yuan’s perception, but rather the ‘special privileges’ of being the Xuanhuang Secret Realm’s half-owner.

Although Lin Yuan had not yet completely refined the Core of the Secret Realm, he had refined 95% of it, and his control over it goes without saying.

“Knowing that I have the ability to kill Hunyi, yet still inviting so many reinforcements… is it to probe my true strength?” Lin Yuan pondered, guessing the purposes of the several peak Different Species.

Those few subtle presences, much stronger than Hunyi, inviting such existences, what would the cost be?

“Probing my true strength…” Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm.

When previously killing Hunyi, Lin Yuan had only activated the power of two hundred million Spatial Layers.

Two hundred million Spatial Layers… Although it was unprecedented, compared to the more than twenty billion Spatial Layers Lin Yuan had truly opened up, it was nothing.

“I still cannot reveal all my strength…” Lin Yuan decided.

Previously, in the history of the Cosmic Starry Sky at the Ninth Rank, the most Spatial Layers someone had opened were not more than one hundred million.

Lin Yuan opening two hundred million Spatial Layers was truly unimaginable, but it still hadn’t exceeded by too much, and should he reveal more than twenty billion Spatial Layers…

Lin Yuan felt that even Supreme Beings would be shocked and might make a move regardless of their pride.

Two hundred million Spatial Layers didn’t concern a Supreme Being, but more than twenty billion Spatial Layers was a different matter.

The apparent tenfold difference was actually more like a difficulty increase by hundreds, thousands, even tens of thousands of times.

…

Down in the canyon.

The numerous Ninth Rank Alien Races were observing Lin Yuan.

Just then.

Under the shocked gazes of all the Ninth Rank Alien Races, the Galaxy Master standing in the void raised his right hand and pressed down toward them.

A rumble sounded.

The force of two hundred million Spatial Layers came crushing down, threatening to annihilate everything in front of them.

“Not good,” the Ninth Rank Insect Race’s expression changed drastically, he immediately roared loudly, “Fellows, won’t you make a move yet?”

Whoosh.

Four presences suddenly converged, coming together from all directions, one of them being a tree-like life form whose branches trembled, vibrating with the vast force of space.

Another presence belonged to an elder personified life form with golden dragon scales; with his every move, terrifying vitality spread out.

The four powerful beings joined hands to oppose the Galaxy Master; each of their strengths was far beyond Hunyi, with the Spatial Layers they had opened numbering close to ninety million, near a hundred million.

…

At a far distance from the canyon, a multitude of Ninth Rank powerhouses were watching the spectacle.

These Ninth Rank powerhouses, were mostly uninvolved with Human Civilization and not on the list for this encirclement, so they could casually stay here.
